name: tc-bsl-viewer
description: BSLView (Total Commander Lister plugin), BSLEdit, the 1c-form-viewer MCP server and the VS Code extension. All four render 1C forms and templates with the shared code in packages/1c-preview-core. The C++ plugin itself is built by build.bat, not npm.

scripts.test: npm run sync && npm run test:viewer && npm run test --workspace=1c-preview-core && npm run test --workspace=1c-form-viewer && npm run test --workspace=1c-form-viewer-vscode && npm run verify
